- Channel 0 (agent): W1 L2 is strongest in a bottom-center blob, e.g. (r6,c3)=18.01, (r6,c4)=16.86, (r6,c5)=16.41, (r5,c5)=16.14, (r7,c4)=15.90. This suggests a single controlled entity near the bottom that can move in multiple directions, not a full-row paddle.  
- Channel 1 (moving objects): strong periodic structure across rows 2â7, e.g. (r3,c6)=7.19, (r3,c2)=7.09, (r6,c8)=5.45, (r6,c4)=5.44. This looks like several moving objects arranged in horizontal lanes.  
- Channel 2 (reward targets): very strong along row 1 across columns 1â8, e.g. (r1,c2)=1.38, (r1,c1)=1.37, (r1,c4)=1.36, (r1,c5)=1.36, (r1,c3)=1.34. This is a goal strip at the top of the playable area.  
- Channel 3 (obstacles): strongest on the outer border, e.g. (r8,c0)=1.35, (r1,c9)=1.34, (r0,c6)=1.33, (r9,c2)=1.33, (r0,c9)=1.33. Internal obstacle weights are weak, so the main obstacles are the walls.  
- Channel 4 (previous frame): scattered strong cells across the playable area, e.g. (r5,c2)=8.33, (r4,c7)=8.14, (r3,c8)=7.10, (r8,c5)=6.91, (r3,c1)=6.30, consistent with previous positions of the agent and multiple moving objects.

Reasoning:  
The top-row reward strip plus multiple horizontal lanes of moving objects strongly suggests a road-crossing game where the agent must reach the top while avoiding cars. Breakout is ruled out because the agent map is a bottom-center blob, not a full bottom-row paddle, and the moving objects are not a single ball. Space Invaders is ruled out because the agent would be a bottom ship moving only left/right, and the moving objects would be concentrated at the top. Snake/Pac-Man are ruled out because reward targets are not scattered; they are concentrated at the top row. Freeway fits perfectly: a chicken starts near the bottom center, crosses lanes of cars, and tries to reach the top row.

Game: Freeway (the MinAtar version of the Atari game Freeway).

Description: The agent controls a chicken at the bottom of the grid, moving up/down/left/right to cross a multi-lane road filled with moving cars. Reward is given for reaching the top row, while colliding with a car ends the episode.

Confidence: 90%
